ladder.label: TOPPING
ladder.why: Daily momentum just crossed down and price lost its 10-day average mid-cycle.
ladder.next: Trim or tighten stops; next likely support is the daily-cycle timing band (~day 36-42, now day 22).
ladder.regime_line: Bigger picture: BULLISH — weekly momentum positive (investor cycle week 13 · daily cycle day 22).
points: Bigger picture is bullish (with-trend for a daily long)
Macro: US net liquidity contracting — caution on the odds
Swing low printed (buyers rejected the low)

entry.text: Momentum rolled over and the 10-day average is lost — reduce or tighten stops.
entry.text_zh: 动量已掉头向下且失守 10 日均线——减仓或收紧止损。

cycle_plain.daily_line: Daily cycle: day 22 of a typical 36–42 trading days
cycle_plain.daily_line_zh: 日线周期：第 22 天，典型周期为 36–42 个交易日
cycle_plain.weekly_line: Weekly (investor) cycle: week 13 of a typical 16–26 weeks
cycle_plain.weekly_phase: mid — the bigger up-leg is maturing
cycle_plain.weekly_line_zh: 周线（投资者）周期：第 13 周，典型周期为 16–26 周
cycle_plain.weekly_phase_zh: 中期——更大的上行段正在成熟
cycle_plain.translation: The last cycle peaked in its SECOND half ('right-translated') — strong cycles top late, a healthy-uptrend sign.
cycle_plain.translation_zh: 上一周期在后半段见顶（“右移”）——强周期见顶偏晚，属于健康上涨趋势的信号。

ladder.why_zh: 日线动量刚刚向下交叉，且价格在周期中段失守 10 日均线。
ladder.next_zh: 减仓或收紧止损；下一个可能的支撑是日线周期的时间窗口 （约第 36-42 天，现为第 22 天）。
ladder.regime_line_zh: 大局：看多 — 周线动量为正（投资者周期第 13 周 · 日线周期第 22 天）。
ladder.summary_line_zh: 短期（日线）：做顶中。大局（顺势）：看多。
points_zh: 大局为看多（对日线多头而言属顺势）
宏观：美国净流动性收缩——对概率属需谨慎
摆动低点已现（买方拒绝了该低点）
仍位于 10 日均线之下
日线动量刚刚向下交叉
ladder.liq_line: Macro headwind: US net liquidity is contracting — buy setups have historically had worse odds and deeper drawdowns here, so demand extra confirmation and smaller size. An odds edge, not a forecast.
ladder.liq_line_zh: 宏观逆风：美国净流动性正在收缩——在此环境下买入形态历史上胜率更低、回撤更深，因此应要求更多确认并降低仓位。这是概率优势，并非预测。
ladder.age_line: ⏱ TOPPING signal triggered 1 trading day ago (~2026-06-16), switching from UPTREND. Signal strength: moderate (score -40/100).
ladder.age_line_zh: ⏱ 做顶中信号于 1 个交易日前触发（约 2026-06-16），自上涨趋势切换而来。 信号强度：中等（评分 -40/100）。
ladder.eq_label_zh: 入场质量：偏弱卖出/离场形态（-34）
ladder.eq_tip: How well-timed & low-risk THIS entry is — near the cycle high, a fresh momentum turn, and with-trend. Measured: entries near the pivot drew ~30% smaller drawdowns than chasers far above it — risk control, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.eq_tip_zh: 衡量当前入场的时机与风险——贴近周期高点、动量新近转向、且顺势。实测：贴近枢轴的入场，其回撤比远离枢轴的追高者约小 30%——这是风险控制，并非收益预测。

profile.description: American Homes 4 Rent, doing business as AMH, is a real estate investment trust based in Las Vegas, Nevada, that invests in single-family rental homes. As of December 31, 2019, the company owned 52,552 homes in 22 states.
profile.description_zh: American Homes 4 Rent（以AMH名义经营）是一家总部位于内华达州拉斯维加斯的房地产投资信托基金，专注于独栋住宅租赁。截至2019年12月31日，该公司在22个州拥有52,552套住宅。

headline.en: Long-duration name into a restrictive, rising-real-rate regime — rate-neutral.
headline.zh: 长久期标的进入偏紧、实际利率上行的环境——利率中性。

detail.en: Own orthogonal rate (TLT) beta +0.47 ± 0.11 — high precision. Sector anchor (XLRE) reads long-duration (+0.35). Inflation-neutral.
detail.zh: 自身正交利率（TLT）beta +0.47 ± 0.11——精度高。 板块锚（XLRE）为长久期（+0.35）。 通胀中性。

caveat.en: Single-name secondary betas are noisy — trust the portfolio aggregate, not any one stock's rate beta (measured out-of-sample persistence ≈ 0.36).
caveat.zh: 单一个股的次级beta噪声很大——应相信组合层面的汇总，而非任何单只股票的利率beta（实测样本外持续性约0.36）。
